request: Overhaul the existing website UI and UX against the supplied design-system handoff, beyond palette changes.

constraints.text: Preserve the current Calendar UX structure.

target: Existing website at desktop and phone widths. Native sheet examples provide reference behavior; do not add a separate native app.
evidence_rule: A checked item needs rendered comparison and relevant interaction evidence. Source edits, builds or prior partial passes alone do not establish design fidelity.

requirements.requirement: Color and aspect palette
Display, reading, UI and technical typography
Spacing, surface radii and elevation
Buttons, segmented controls, glyphs and avatars
Avatar initials use UI sans, large 20px role and teal/white owner treatment in both themes
Desktop centered navigation, date control and menu
Phone navigation and accessible menu
Account and Settings destinations, theme and sign-out
Concentric sign, planet, house and aspect fields
Computed placements, degrees, ticks and house numbers
Inside angle badges and aspect colors
Default aspect network and keyboard inspector
Natal, transit, synastry, composite and fullscreen variants
Open-page wheel and daily reading
Effort section and calculated placements
Grouped Planets, Points and Angles
Date/location changes, deep links, loading and failures
Profile identity and segmented Natal/Transits navigation
Wheel, Big Three and joined sect pill
Planets, points, angles and empty houses
Insights and complete linked readings
Transit cards and reports
requirements.note: Transit layout, overlay and fullscreen verified. Existing Reports entry retained; no paid report generation or purchase was performed.

requirements.requirement: Identity and Compatibility/Transits/Natal/Synastry/Composite navigation
Relationship story cards, wheels and placement lists
Saved chart, comparison and fullscreen interactions
Stable Feed/Circle/Charts/Requests header and counts
Grouped feed and all supported card types
requirements.note: Calculated three-day fixed-composite cards now lead Today, followed by existing personal transit cards. Prototype historical event catalogue remains outside this local feature.

requirements.requirement: Birthdays and Friction/Flow details
requirements.note: Saved person-chart birthdays and three-day fixed-composite Friction/Flow details are implemented and verified locally. Connected-friend birthday sharing still needs a privacy-safe consented field.

requirements.requirement: Circle search, requests, saved charts and add menu
Invite creation, link-ready state and sharing
Calculated three-day Friction/Flow cards, day details and recovery
requirements.note: Known birth times and mutual sharing required. A11 fact-only/no-summary variant. Proposed conjunction meanings and prototype prose are not served.

requirements.requirement: All / Circle / Charts feed sources, including saved person charts
requirements.note: Both transit and three-day composite cards use the selected source. All includes both, Circle excludes saved charts, Charts excludes Circle. Choice persists per owner and survives article return/reload. Event charts remain outside personal relationship forecasts.

requirements.requirement: Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Seasonal/Planets navigation
Date-first reading, sign chips and previous/next controls
evidence: tests/visual/design-handoff-pages.spec.ts: horoscope handoff fidelity across all periods

requirements.requirement: Explore signs and existing planet-reading navigation
requirements.scope_note: The new visual correction covers Explore signs. It does not claim a new pixel comparison of every Planets card.

requirements.requirement: Loading, empty and publication states
What's behind it: published calculation facts, placement links and private authoring boundary
requirements.scope_note: Only edition-matched recorded Swiss positions and houses are projected. Illustrative prototype descriptions are not approved source copy; missing summary fields remain omitted.

areas.fidelity_correction: The owner identified that the prior generic-pill Previous/Next implementation did not match the handoff. Earlier token/navigation passes did not establish visual fidelity. The October 25 correction verifies the actual date-labelled chevron structure and adds the omitted context section.

requirements.requirement: Placement and transit headers, pills and full prose
Aspect rows and calculated facts
Deep links, back navigation and reload
Preserve current Day/Week/Month structure and navigation
Shared palette, typography and surfaces
Month cells, event chips, day panel and reading links
Journal, subscriptions and saved-state behavior
Account identity and editable details
Settings controls and sections
Sign out on Account, modal and mobile variants
Approved loader shapes, scale and timing
Reduced motion, initial page and inline loading
Login and sign-up visual review against supplied references
Keep supported authentication providers and verification functional
requirements.note: Existing provider/verification code retained. Local tests cover form navigation, controls and synthetic authentication; no live identity-provider login was performed.

requirements.requirement: Profile/chart information and unknown-time state
Retain current learning information architecture
Apply shared site chrome and typography
Reading and guide navigation remain functional

calculation.civil_days: Three consecutive dates in the viewing location timezone, including 23/25-hour DST dates. 15-minute shared Swiss samples, exact roots refined to 20ms and local minima refined for stations. End boundary belongs to the following date.
calculation.strength: round(moving-body base units * (1 - 0.75 * closest daily orb)); bases Sun/Mercury/Venus 100, Moon 35, Mars 125, Jupiter 150, Saturn/Uranus/Neptune/Pluto 200. Reproduces the independently supplied Uranus reference on all three dates.
calculation.classification: Sextile/trine = flow; square/opposition = friction; conjunction unrated. A significant unrated contact yields Active. Neither channel reaches 30 = Quiet. Mixed requires both channels >=30 and weaker total at least half the stronger total, with distinct displayed drivers. Otherwise Easy/Tense follows the larger channel.
calculation.continuation: Recomputed and retained on every qualifying local day, including when no exact pass occurs that day.
